intent: First prereg public-EEG source-only nested transfer regularization pilot; publish ALL 8 subjects and all negative results; NOT sufficient for journal generalization
data: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery EEGBCI 1.0.0 via MNE
license: Follow PhysioNet EEGMMIDB dataset terms and citations
tasks: Left (T1) versus right (T2) hand imagery; do not mix hands/feet runs with opposite T1/T2 semantics
outer_cv: Leave one ENTIRE subject out; all 8 subjects reported, no excludes
inner_cv: Leave one source subject out inside each outer train; no heldout epoch/label in selection
method: Cross-subject directional-coherence-dependent spectral shrinkage, signed direction consistency estimated from training labels only
comparators: same-base ridge with no directional penalty (ablation)
Ledoit-Wolf auto shrinkage LDA on same log-PSD features
CSP+regularized LDA on same 8-30Hz EEG epochs (not same feature representation)
statistic: Report each subject result, paired per-subject deltas, exact signflip exploratory test with all eight; no null superiority claim if p>0.05
strong_baseline_guard: If CSP+LDA wins or candidate underperforms, report failure and do not claim SOTA
